---
title: "Resonance & Eigenmodes"

Find the frequencies and fields of a bounded electromagnetic model.
Choose an unloaded, LC-loaded, or explicit RLC-loaded model according to the
physical system you want to calculate.

## Choose the model

| Model | Starting tutorial |
| --- | --- |
| Unloaded finite CPW | [Palace](../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/palace_eigenmode.ipynb) · <a href="../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/palace_eigenmode.ipynb" data-noresolveinput download>IPYNB</a> · <a href="../../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/palace_eigenmode.qmd" data-noresolveinput download>QMD</a> or [HFSS](../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/aedt_hfss_eigenmode.ipynb) · <a href="../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/aedt_hfss_eigenmode.ipynb" data-noresolveinput download>IPYNB</a> · <a href="../../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/aedt_hfss_eigenmode.qmd" data-noresolveinput download>QMD</a> |
| Pad with an explicit linear inductive branch | [SimplePad Palace](../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/palace_eigenmode.ipynb) · <a href="../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/palace_eigenmode.ipynb" data-noresolveinput download>IPYNB</a> · <a href="../../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/palace_eigenmode.qmd" data-noresolveinput download>QMD</a> or [HFSS](../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_hfss_eigenmode.ipynb) · <a href="../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_hfss_eigenmode.ipynb" data-noresolveinput download>IPYNB</a> · <a href="../../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_hfss_eigenmode.qmd" data-noresolveinput download>QMD</a> |
| Curved pad boundary | [CircularPad Palace](../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CircularPad/palace_eigenmode.ipynb) · <a href="../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CircularPad/palace_eigenmode.ipynb" data-noresolveinput download>IPYNB</a> · <a href="../../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CircularPad/palace_eigenmode.qmd" data-noresolveinput download>QMD</a> |
| Closed TSV model | [TSV HFSS Eigenmode](../tsv-model-inspection.qmd) |

Use the selected tutorial's solver environment, conductor connectivity, stack,
and exterior. Its search frequency and requested mode count select the
calculation; mesh and adaptation settings control its discretization.

## Loaded modes {#loaded-modes}

The [CPW–meander RLC tutorial](../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwMeanderAirbridge/aedt_hfss_eigenmode_rlc.ipynb) · <a href="../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwMeanderAirbridge/aedt_hfss_eigenmode_rlc.ipynb" data-noresolveinput download>IPYNB</a> · <a href="../../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/ComponentSimulation/CpwMeanderAirbridge/aedt_hfss_eigenmode_rlc.qmd" data-noresolveinput download>QMD</a>
adds explicit linear loading on the selected assembly. Preserve its support
sheet, enabled branches, topology, and contact directions.
This model does not add Josephson nonlinearity automatically.

## Read the modes

Identify modes using their actual fields, not frequency order alone.
Read frequency and adaptive history together; report native Q only when
the selected loss model and returned output provide it.

For interface or junction energy analysis, continue with
[Participation & Surface Loss](epr-loss.qmd).
